issues.description: The problem statement's UML and explanatory text declare Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning a boolean (and explicitly states it should return true/false), but the provided solution declares Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String and implements Goat/Seal.messageOnMilk() to return descriptive String messages. This mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students about the correct interface signature and return type and may cause compilation or test failures depending on which signature they implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and solution. Either (A) change the problem statement UML and explanatory text to specify messageOnMilk():String and describe the expected string message (e.g., "Seal <name> is milked"), or (B) modify the solution and example code to make messageOnMilk() return a boolean and adjust Goat/Seal implementations and any example printing accordingly. Prefer option (A) if the intended behavior is to produce human-readable messages, and update problem_statement.md (UML and narrative) to reflect messageOnMilk():String.

issues.description: The contract for messageOnMilk() is inconsistent across the problem statement and the provided solution: the problem statement's UML/interface listing indicates messageOnMilk() returns a boolean (and the prose at lines 92-95 describes returning true/false), while other parts of the problem UML and the solution implementation define messageOnMilk() as returning a String (e.g., "Seal [name] is milked"). This contradiction leaves students unsure whether to implement messageOnMilk() with a boolean return type or a String message and will cause compilation or behavioral mismatches between implemented code and the textual requirements.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the messageOnMilk() contract across artifacts. Preferably update the problem statement so messageOnMilk() is specified to return a String (and change the prose that currently says it should return true/false to instead describe the returned message, e.g. "returns a message like 'Seal [name] is milked'"). Alternatively, if boolean was intended, change the solution interface and implementations (Milkable, Seal, Goat) to return boolean and update all code and examples that expect a String. Ensure the UML, textual description, template examples, and solution use the same signature and description.
